LAREDO — Here is your Webb County week ahead: a cool, cloudy start, a steady warm-up through the week, and thunderstorms to close out the weekend.

Monday is the coolest day, cloudy, with a high near 64 and a low near 54. Rain chance 20 percent, north-northeast wind 12 mph, gusts to 16 mph. Tuesday brings morning clouds and afternoon sun, high near 68, low near 54, with no rain expected.

Wednesday stays cloudy, high near 72, low near 58. Thursday warms up, mostly cloudy, high near 76, low near 60, 20 percent chance of showers after noon. Friday is the best day of the week — mostly cloudy, high near 78, low near 64, only a 10 percent rain chance.

Saturday is the warmest day, partly cloudy, high near 80, low near 66, thunderstorms arriving late, 70 percent overnight. Sunday turns stormy, with thunderstorms, a high near 77 and a low near 66, 60 percent rain chance.

Winds stay 5 to 12 mph, shifting north early in the week to southeast by the weekend. No weather alerts are in effect for Webb County. Bottom line: Monday, grab a jacket; Friday and Saturday, get out; Sunday, keep the umbrella handy.

Sources:

  • Weather.com — Laredo, TX 10-day forecast
  • National Weather Service — Laredo, TX forecast
